title: Trump is running out of time as he tries to restrict mail voting
description: Two swing states are sending ballots, and other states plan to send theirs soon.

title: Inside Pirro’s special grand jury probe into D.C. agencies supervising kids
description: The investigation appears focused on whether officials are adequately supervising children in and out of school, with scrutiny on attendance and social worker visits.

title: These are the most important House races to watch in November
description: Democrats are favored to win the House, but Republicans have viable paths to keeping control. These are the key themes and races to keep an eye on.

title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner land for talks in Kyiv after meeting Putin in Moscow
description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are set to arrive in Kyiv on Sunday in their first visit to the Ukrainian capital as part of a renewed push for peace in Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

title: Trump removes White House shrouds as he prepares for Xi visit
description: The president had ordered repairs to the iconic, and Ionic, columns outside the White House entrance.

title: Trump begins major midterm spending with $10 million ad buy in Texas
description: Republicans, nervous about the tight Senate race in the Lone Star state, hope Trump’s political war chest can boost GOP nominee Ken Paxton.

title: The mystery behind an audio clip that helped upend a Senate race
description: Artificial-intelligence tools increasingly allow political actors to fool voters — and help candidates cast doubt on reality.

title: ChatGPT bans campaigns from using AI to make ads. They’re doing it anyway.
description: A Washington Post review found 39 campaigns that disclosed payments to AI companies, but consultants say many more do it and don’t disclose it.

title: Republican House candidates tone down Trump on their campaign websites
description: Several congressional hopefuls have removed or downplayed mentions of the president and his priorities as Trump’s popularity wanes.

title: Trump administration to dig at triumphal arch site despite no final federal approvals
description: The Trump administration says it will break ground on a 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., without final federal approval and despite an ongoing lawsuit.

title: Week in Politics: Trump's face on the coin; reshaping the capital; the midterms
description: President Trump is the first living president to have his face on a coin. He's also reshaping Washington in his image, and working to influence midterm elections.

title: Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms
description: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.

title: Flock cameras draw opposition from across the political spectrum
description: As political races heat up heading into the midterms, candidates from both parties are increasingly joining the fray to voice concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

title: In boost to GOP, Supreme Court says parties should get lower TV ad rates
description: The Supreme Court ruled Friday that political parties should get discounted TV ad rates when they coordinate spending with candidates.

title: Trump moves to allow ranchers and hunters to kill gray wolves
description: The president ordered his administration to lift Endangered Species Act protections for gray wolves, again wading into a fraught debate between ranchers and conservationists.

title: Trump says he will spend some, not all, super PAC money on midterms
description: Republicans have fretted over his war chest sitting on the sidelines. The president says he plans to hold onto some of the money for 2028.

title: Judge orders DOJ to disclose who conceived of now-defunct payout fund
description: The Trump administration dropped plans for a fund to compensate people who say they were unfairly prosecuted, but several lawsuits are ongoing.

title: Melania Trump will not attend the Republican midterm convention
description: Scheduled for the middle of next week in Dallas, the event designed to project party unity will be missing a well-known figure.

title: Veterans make emergency request to block construction of Trump’s arch
description: The administration is seeking to render the project a “fait accompli” by moving quickly, the veterans’ lawyers argued Friday.

title: ICE agent charged with lying about Minneapolis shooting released on bail
description: A lawyer for Christian Castro, 52, said he intends to fight the charges and that the agent never had any intention of fleeing to avoid prosecution.

title: Texas Senate hopeful Talarico ramps up Black outreach efforts
description: The Texas Democrat acknowledges criticism that Democrats haven’t been doing enough to court Black voters.

title: Maria Bartiromo’s attorney denies reports she was fired from Fox News
description: The longtime host’s high-profile attorney claims Bartiromo is “still employed” by the network and suggests legal action.

title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
description: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

title: Diesel hits record $5.85 a gallon as Iran war drags on
description: Surging fuel cost puts additional cost pressure on manufacturing and retail.

title: 'Hidden tribunals': Immigration court due process in tumult with new locations
description: The new effort appears to be another tactic in a broader Trump administration strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already limited due process options in order to speed deportations.

title: What happened this week under the Trump administration
description: The president is winning the battle to build his ballroom and has his face on a $1 gold coin.

title: El-Sayed split Michigan Democrats. Whether they unify could decide Senate control
description: After a bruising Senate primary, Michigan Democrats are trying to unify to hold onto a must-win seat. But healing those fissures is proving not so simple.

title: Trump's arch may break ground without final approval. Veterans are trying to stop it
description: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum says "excavation work" will begin in the next two weeks, without approval from a key federal body. Veterans who sued over the arch want a judge to intervene before then.

title: Missouri candidate charged with conspiring to plant drugs on opponent
description: Thomas Christopher Ross is running for Missouri’s House District 161 after narrowly winning the Republican primary against Louise Secker.

title: Trump officials say work will start on triumphal arch within two weeks
description: The planned 250-foot-tall structure near Arlington National Cemetery is one of the president’s top construction priorities.

title: Trump to use Qatari plane for international trip despite security worries
description: President Donald Trump plans to fly to Ireland next week aboard the Boeing 747 gifted by Qatar. Plans to take the plane out of service to upgrade its security have slipped to later this fall.

title: Wesleyan president calls Trump's tax-exempt proposal 'extraordinary overreach'
description: The Trump administration wants to end tax-exempt status for universities with certain race-based programs. Wesleyan President Michael Roth says the plan could frighten schools.
